items.title: S3の「シンプル」はどこまでシンプルか
One spec to validate them all: Testing and fixing agent integrations at scale
items.summary: Temporal ships plugins that make agent SDKs durable, from OpenAI Agents and Google ADK to LangGraph, Strands and Pydantic AI. Before calling them GA, we needed to know how well each one held up, and reading them by hand wasn't going to scale.Every plugin solves the same problem, so we asked them all the same questions. We wrote those questions once, as a single spec precise enough for coding agents to turn each one into a runnable reproduction for every plugin, many of them injecting failures on purpose. The basics held up everywhere. The agents also dug into the corners and found hundreds of defects, most of which only appear in specific setups. Fixes landed within weeks, and every lesson learned on one plugin became a check for the rest.It also went wrong in useful ways: rules the agents couldn't see, and a review loop that burned an absurd number of tokens on one pull request.You'll leave with a recipe for any family of integrations, SDKs or services that share a contract, and a clear view of where humans still have to stay in the loop.

items.title: 「正しいデータ」の定義をAI エージェントとつくるGoogleADKによるデータ品質定義の実践
items.summary: AI エンジニア、データ アナリスト、ML エンジニア、データ エンジニアを対象に、AI エージェントを活用してデータ品質定義を支援する取り組みについて紹介します。Google ADK で構築した AI エージェントが、アプリケーションや業務ドメインの専門家との対話を通じて、データに期待される状態や制約、既存資料に含まれる知識を引き出し、それらを機械的に実行可能なデータ品質ルールへ変換する仕組みを解説します。生成結果は、SQL による品質チェックを含む ODCS 形式の YAML として出力し、Data Scan / Data Quality と組み合わせて継続的な品質検証につなげます。
